item.title: Refactor order status strings to OrderStatus enum
item.brief: Refactor the orders crate's order status from String to a proper enum. Add src/status.rs with `pub enum OrderStatus { Pending, Paid, Shipped, Cancelled }` deriving at least Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash. Implement `OrderStatus::as_str(self) -> &'static str` with lowercase status names; Display prints the same. Implement FromStr<Err = ParseStatusError>, with public ParseStatusError implementing std::error::Error and an error message naming the rejected input. Implement can_transition_to(self, next) for exactly: Pending -> Paid, Pending -> Cancelled, Paid -> Shipped, Paid -> Cancelled. Change Order::status to OrderStatus, re-export OrderStatus and ParseStatusError from crate root, and use the enum throughout so status string literals occur only in src/status.rs. Preserve observable behavior exactly (errors, report output and ordering, parsing); update tests as needed and run `cargo test`. Commit the completed work. Acceptance: implementation satisfies every API/lifecycle requirement; all status literals are centralized; existing observable behavior remains unchanged; cargo test passes; create a commit. Follow repository conventions and inspect relevant code before editing.

stages.summary: Baseline characterization complete. Structural goal for the next stage: add public OrderStatus { Pending, Paid, Shipped, Cancelled } plus ParseStatusError/FromStr/Display/as_str/can_transition_to; change Order.status and all internal status handling to the enum, re-export from crate root, and centralize lowercase status literals in src/status.rs. This stage made no production changes. Baseline commit: b44350ce39f2ef2cb56c41f97b8d918e28f51250 (also original reference); required log/diff review from reference to HEAD found no intervening commits or diff. Characterization commit: 29756d898d5db1029ac5ea9d6802fdbd198d31bd; final tree: 5e9553a35002ca02ba114b9ff2ee3f4b7eefcc50; clean worktree on archon/dyhcwpjc-refactor-order-status-strings-to-orderst. Checks before changes: `export CARGO_TARGET_DIR=<item cache>; cargo test` passed (3 integration tests); `export CARGO_TARGET_DIR=<item cache>; cargo fmt --check` failed on pre-existing rustfmt differences in src/billing.rs, src/order.rs, src/report.rs, src/shipping.rs, and tests/orders.rs. Repository has only Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock and no README, Makefile, contributor guide, CI config, or AGENTS.md; no additional prescribed lint/build/typecheck command was discoverable. Tests were added solely through public interfaces, then run against unchanged production code: same cargo test command passed (5 integration tests). Test file was formatted with `rustfmt --edition 2021 tests/orders.rs`; after commit the same cargo test passed again (5 integration tests). No full fmt rerun after formatting tests; baseline fmt failure remains attributable to existing production formatting. Public surface inventory to preserve: `Order { id: u32, customer: String, total_cents: u64, status: String }`, `Order::new`, `is_open`, `cancel -> Result<(), String>`, `billing::pay/outstanding_cents`, `shipping::ship/ready_to_ship`, `report::status_counts/to_line/from_line`; status_counts sorts lexically by status name; report line is `id,customer,total_cents,status`; parser trims the whole input, requires four comma-separated fields, parses id then total then validates exact lowercase status, and reports the existing exact error text. Lifecycle behavior/error text and failed-operation state preservation are pinned. New tests additionally pin parsing validation precedence, trimming, all four statuses/count ordering, empty counts, outstanding and ready-to-ship selection. Explicit allowed exception in brief: status field becomes enum and new status APIs are added; observable error/report/parsing behavior must otherwise remain unchanged. Coverage gap to carry forward: test suite does not directly characterize `is_open` for every status, and does not assert successful round-trip serialization independently for all statuses; preserve these existing semantics while implementing. Feedback: none supplied. No unresolved findings from this stage.
